findings.claim: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation wraps every analyzer diagnostic and silently drops any whose location is not in source or not in this compilation. Diagnostics with Location.None (for example null-location diagnostics created via GetLocation helpers returning null) are now suppressed. Any diagnostic protecting users from insecure or incorrect configurations that previously surfaced without a location is now silently lost. The filter is broader than the crash fix needed.

receipt_plan.detail: Run analyzer tests with a [MessagePackObject] whose diagnostic is created with a null location (e.g. GetParameterListLocation returning null, or a metadata-declared member). Assert the diagnostic is still reported. Compare diagnostic output on base vs head across the existing analyzer test suite to find newly missing diagnostics.
